description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_postgres' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' and provides methods for handling PostgreSQL database schema operations such as adding, dropping, altering columns, creating/dropping indexes, and renaming tables. It serves as part of a database abstraction layer for PostgreSQL within the ADOdb PHP library.

classes.name: ADODB2_postgres
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_DataDict for PostgreSQL specific database schema operations

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Determines the internal type code for a given database field type for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: actualType
methods.description: Maps internal type codes to actual PostgreSQL data type names.

methods.name: addColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add columns to a PostgreSQL table, handling default values and nullability.

methods.name: dropIndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop an index by name.

methods.name: alterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to alter a column's definition; recreates the table if necessary.

methods.name: dropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a column, either directly or via table recreation depending on PostgreSQL version.

methods.name: _recreate_copy_table
methods.description: Uses a temporary table to recreate and copy data when altering table structure.

methods.name: dropTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a table and associated sequences.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Constructs SQL suffix for column creation, including default, not null, constraints.

methods.name: _dropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Finds the sequence associated with a table's serial column to drop it if necessary.

methods.name: renameTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to rename a PostgreSQL table.

methods.name: _indexSQL
methods.description: Constructs SQL to create an index, with options for uniqueness and index type.

methods.name: _getSize
methods.description: Generates data type size string based on field parameters.

methods.name: changeTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to alter table structure, including adding, altering, or dropping columns.
